scope: All group-owned, inherited group members and add_group_shape owners; no underscore-name exclusion. Shared inherited geometry implementation receipt remains transform-api-map.json.

languageSecurityMapping.names: Retain neutral snake_case properties/methods. Group/ungroup operation options remain camelCase and require explicit tolerance.
languageSecurityMapping.construction: GroupShape and GroupShapes are live returned owner-bound interfaces, not arbitrary public raw-XML constructors; pending model support is not classified as private.
languageSecurityMapping.protocols: GroupShapes requires length, Symbol.iterator and checked zero-based lookup; negative access uses at(index). No unsupported slice promise. Equality maps to owner/object identity rather than wrapper reference identity.
languageSecurityMapping.io: In-memory graph access synchronous; bytes admission and package mutation async with explicit capabilities. No host paths, ambient clocks/fonts/network or native runtime.
languageSecurityMapping.values: Length remains finite exact safe integer EMUs; strict booleans/numbers, null only for absence. Source type/value/index errors need neutral typed errors; unsupported operation uses unsupported-edit.
languageSecurityMapping.ownership: Original child shape IDs and sibling order persist. New group ID must be unique in its part. Cross-owner handles reject; affected unremappable references reject atomically.

drift: The original automatic add_group_shape(shapes=[]) model permits empty groups and recalculates ancestors. The bounded shapes.group operation requires at least two sibling shapes and explicit tolerance. It is an additional operation, not complete model parity.
Historical register batch routes are proposed, not executable schema claims. This receipt names only actual bounded operation routes.
GroupShape inherits members declared on BaseShape; all are retained below. Underscore-prefixed implementation bases are represented by their inherited public owners, not removed.

toleranceProof: Nonidentity ungroup certifies all rectangle vertices and bounding corners after serialization using exact BigInt rational arithmetic for quarter-turn ancestor/child transform chains. General-angle nonidentity transforms reject because no exact bound is established. Identity wrapping/unwrapping preserves arbitrary angles and unchanged child XML structurally; zero tolerance remains exact. Fractional displacements at large world offsets cannot round into an accidental pass.
referencePolicy: Ungroup rejects populated timing/extLst trees in the owning drawing, unknown group metadata/actions, references to the removed group, and unsupported affected timing attributes. Child IDs and supported connector targets remain unchanged. No general timing/extension retargeting support is claimed.
